issues: No integrity problems: the change only randomizes which small circle is removed and reinserted (one of the 6 smallest, weighted 1/rank), and the repair step still checks validity.
Assumes rng is seeded from the seed argument as in the incumbent; this is not visible in the diff.
Recomputed z = (2.63515 - 2.6311) / (0.0023 * sqrt(1/2 + 1/2)) = 0.00405 / 0.0023 = about 1.76, slightly below the reported 1.788, probably because the harness used unrounded values.
The evidence is borderline (z below about 2 with 2 runs vs 2); the gain may be partly noise, so one more replicate is worth considering.
The candidate's mean sum of radii (about 2.6352) is plausible because it is below the published best of about 2.6360.
